experiments.mechanism: Actual maintained LSH retrieval feeds SparseAttentionServer correction/attention and dense selected-body attention through a persistent checked CPU protocol.

conditions.execution: CPU-only actual selected bodies; dim128, one KV head, GQA1/4/8, bounded padded buffers and uniform nonempty lengths
conditions.seed: fixed literal dyadic coordinates/projections, no RNG
conditions.scope: Persistent C++ owner and selected Python host cache; sorted fill, exact selected sets, actual correction logits/probabilities/output/LSE, two append steps, clear and refill; immutable provenance gate
conditions.oracle: Independent FP64 raw key/value/query union enumerator, K1/L2 inclusion enumeration with released +1e-4; p1 explicit dense baseline full mode
conditions.sanitizers: C++ bridge self-test and connected bridge calls are ASan/UBSan/LSan instrumented by --sanitize; Python host adapter not instrumented
conditions.dense_path: Actual qk_kernel_full→softmax_kernel_full→wv_kernel_dim128_full selected-body surrogate for unexecuted FlashInfer; original server optimized-tail path remains unsupported (#72)

experiments.note: Literal projection conditioning is a deterministic mechanism fixture, not empirical inclusion-probability or accuracy verification. Portable SIMD/copy/Tensor/BF16 dependency models and serial execution replace dependencies. Native SIMD, scheduler/threads, Torch, FBGEMM linkage, CUDA, FlashInfer, model weights and datasets unexecuted. Full retrieval is routed explicitly to actual qk/full-softmax/wv without correction; all-candidate sparse path remains corrected and differs from dense. Known repairs remain open.
